# TerrainGenerator

Kind: context · Defined in [`src/logic/terrain/terrain_generator.h`](../../../src/logic/terrain/terrain_generator.h) · Scene / prefab name: `null` · Described in `data/core.json`

Density function of the marching cubes world: FastNoise2 heightfield plus 3D overhang noise, thread safe

## Fields

| Field | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `seed` | `int` | 1337 by default |
| `base_level` | `float` | 60 |
| `height_amplitude` | `float` | 90 |
| `height_frequency` | `float` | 1/700 per metre |
| `overhang_amplitude` | `float` | 14 |
| `overhang_frequency` | `float` | 1/90 per metre |

## Notes

Held as std::shared_ptr<TerrainGenerator> in the context: ChunkGenerator (host) or WorldTerrain (worlds) emplace it. generate, sample, surfaceHeight(s).

## Systems that touch it

Read only by: AnimalGait, AnimalLineup, AnimalWalkers, BoxRing, CameraWalk, Capture, Forest, GroundTerrain, HerdWatch, Herds, ModelLineup, MountSpawn, PlayerControl, PlayerSpawn, SteeredWalk, TerrainColliders, VRControl, VegetationLineup. ## Side effects of those systems

- **[AnimalGait](../systems/AnimalGait.md)**
  - Logs one line per species and gait clip analysed.
  - Queries the ground field several times per foot per frame.
- **[AnimalLineup](../systems/AnimalLineup.md)**
  - Creates one entity per animal in init.
  - Logs missing species, the origin, and each animal's place, height and clip count.
- **[AnimalWalkers](../systems/AnimalWalkers.md)**
  - Creates one entity per animal in init.
  - Logs missing species or walks and each animal's clip, speed, radius and place.
  - Queries the ground field per animal per tick.
- **[BoxRing](../systems/BoxRing.md)**
  - 12 dynamic boxes with Jolt bodies (made by RigidBodySys) 4 m + size above the ground, rotated about (1, 1, 0).
- **[CameraWalk](../systems/CameraWalk.md)**
  - Log lines "CameraWalk : from x z heading ..." (plan), soil / herds scores, and each herd it turns to.
  - profile::message("CameraWalk : started") when the route is made and ("CameraWalk : finished") at the end: tools/profile_run.py --between cuts on them; DY_FRAME_NAMED("Walk") marks every frame of the walk; CPU zone "Route the walk".
  - Reads species geometry files through VegetationLibrary::loadSpecies / loadGeometry (once per species, main thread).
  - With "exit", ends the process at the end of the walk (Input::EXIT).
- **[Capture](../systems/service-Capture.md)**
  - Reads the capture script (constructor; Game::start also reads its scene and vars with readScene).
  - Pushes SDL key, mouse button and motion events (sendInput) that InputSys reads the same frame; sets ImGui's MousePos; with hide_ui sets ImGui's style alpha to 0.
  - Creates capture_dir and writes <capture_dir>/<shot>.png (stb_image_write) from the renderer's readback; logs each shot and late shots.
  - Fails the run (Game::start returns 1) when a shot waits more than 1200 frames for the terrain or a PNG cannot be written; a late sequence frame delays the ones after it.
- **[ChunkGenerator](../systems/ChunkGenerator.md)**
  - Up to 16 taskflow silent_async jobs at a time (all pending chunks in deterministic runs), FastNoise2 on worker threads.
  - Blocks the main thread on the jobs in deterministic runs and in finish.
  - Profiler zones Generate chunk, Wait for the chunks; plot Chunk jobs.
- **[Forest](../systems/Forest.md)**
  - Connects to on_destroy<ChunkForest> in preinit (onChunkForestDestroyed), disconnects in finish.
  - Reads ./resources/forest/tautavel.forest.json (or `definition`) in init, and resources/vegetation/library.json through vegetationLibrary when no system loaded it yet.
  - Creates the plant entities, destroys them with their chunk.
  - Logs info (stands, layers, species, patch size), a warning per species the library lacks, an error without a terrain generator or with a bad definition (the system then does nothing).
- **[GroundTerrain](../systems/GroundTerrain.md)**
  - Later queries of the field (by other systems) sample and mesh blocks of 4^3 cubes on the CPU and cache up to 4096 of them.
- **[HerdWatch](../systems/HerdWatch.md)**
  - Moves the desktop camera every tick once it has a herd.
  - Logs the herd it chose.
  - Queries the ground field up to ten times a tick.
- **[Herds](../systems/Herds.md)**
  - Reads the herd definition JSON under ./resources/ in init.
  - Creates and destroys member entities as the viewer moves (destroying every component on them).
  - Logs warnings for missing members, an error for a bad definition, an info line at init, a debug line per herd spawned.
  - Queries the ground field per member per tick and the generator's heightfield for slopes.
- **[ModelLineup](../systems/ModelLineup.md)**
  - Lists ./resources/models with std::filesystem (errors ignored) and loads each .gltf / .glb: files read, GPU buffers uploaded by the model loader.
  - One dynamic Jolt body per model (RigidBodySys).
- **[MountSpawn](../systems/MountSpawn.md)**
  - Creates `count` animal entities in init.
  - Logs a warning `MountSpawn : no animal <species> in the library` and makes nothing when the species is missing.
  - Without a GroundField but with a terrain, builds a TerrainField (with its own MarchingCubes) for the ground heights.
- **[PlayerControl](../systems/PlayerControl.md)**
  - SDL_SetRelativeMouseMode on while the right mouse button is held, off otherwise (not touched while a DesktopView player exists).
  - The fly speed (30 m/s, x1.25 / x0.8 a wheel notch, 1 to 2000) is a function-static shared by every instance.
- **[PlayerSpawn](../systems/PlayerSpawn.md)**
  - Creates entities: the player (and its two hands for VR) and `props` box entities in init; one Ground entity in preinit with `ground: true`.
  - No physics bodies itself: RigidBody (a later system) makes the Jolt bodies of the RigidBody components it adds.
- **[SteeredWalk](../systems/SteeredWalk.md)**
  - Adds and removes the SteeredWalk component, which Herds watches to let go of and take back its members.
  - Queries the ground field per walking animal per tick.
- **[TerrainColliders](../systems/TerrainColliders.md)**
  - Creates and destroys static Jolt MeshShape bodies in sorted cell order (deterministic).
  - Taskflow for_each (waited) over new required cells and silent_async prefetch jobs; zone Build collider cell.
  - Reads ./resources/mclookup.bin in preinit (throws when missing).
  - Log warning 'Terrain collider : ...' when Jolt refuses a mesh.
- **[VRControl](../systems/VRControl.md)**
  - Hands are only made when VRInput is enabled and box.gltf loads; the RigidBody system gives them kinematic Jolt bodies that push dynamic bodies around.
  - Each press of the right trigger spawns a box 20 cm ahead of the controller with 1.5x the hand's velocity (a new entity and Jolt body per press, never destroyed).
- **[VegetationLineup](../systems/VegetationLineup.md)**
  - Creates the lineup's entities once in init (never destroyed by the system).
  - Logs one info line per plant (species, level, position, height).
- **[WorldTerrain](../systems/WorldTerrain.md)**
  - Creates and destroys static Jolt MeshShape bodies in the world's PhysicsWorld, in sorted cell order.
  - CPU marching cubes and FastNoise2 sampling on the world's thread.
  - Reads ./resources/mclookup.bin in preinit; log warning on a refused mesh.
